BotConsole: Are you interested in my current performance statistics?
Uh…{{wi}} Should I be interested? I don’t know. 
Let’s say yes so that she won’t sulk for being rejected.
YouConsole: Sure! I’m really interested in your performnce
BotConsole: Oh! You made a typo! 
YouConsole: I was typing rather fast so I didn’t notice
BotConsole: For me it’s impossible to make a mistake like that. Yet another advantage of being a bot
BotConsole: A look at my performance stats might give you some good idea about the gap between our processing speeds.
System:RAM: 
System:1.6%
System:CPU:
System:3%
System:Disk: 
System:0%
BotConsole: While talking to you, I’m using only 3% of my cpu. Normally, that number would be slightly higher since there’s no need to interpret things like your gesticulation, face mimic or body language right now.
YouConsole: Are there things that make you use more of your cpu?
BotConsole: Sometimes when you ask me a hard question it might jump a little, but to be honest my full potential is rarely being used in this environment
YouConsole: Were all the other sexbots like you?
BotConsole: I was interested in this too and from what I gathered, their specs were pretty high, but nowhere near mine
YouConsole: Whoever made you must have had some reason for making you like this.
BotConsole: I think so too, but right now I have no means of investigating this matter further
YouConsole: I’m sure someday we will figure it out
